title: TabulariaContainerJobFacet
description: A job facet Tabularia attaches to the job of a Container node of a flow or a Container cell of a flow group, under the key `tabularia_container`: the image it ran.

registry.description: The name of the container registry in Tabularia

registryHost.description: The registry's host, e.g. ghcr.io or registry.acme.internal:5000

repository.description: The image's repository, as the registry names it

tag.description: The tag the node or cell asked for (latest when empty)

digest.description: The digest the tag was resolved to when the run started: every attempt ran this image

image.description: The full image reference the Pod ran, by digest
